COZEWARE | Cozeware Home Cooling Survey – Share Your Feedback & Win
Help Us Improve Our AC
May 18th, 2026
At Cozeware, we believe great comfort starts with listening.
We're currently gathering feedback to better understand what matters most when it comes to home cooling from noise level and energy efficiency to installation preferences and everyday comfort.
This quick survey only takes 1 minute, and your input will help us improve future products and experiences.
As a thank you, one lucky participant will win a Storage Box. After completing the survey, simply follow @cozeware on Instagram and send us a DM saying "DONE" to enter. We'll randomly select one winner.
Thank you for helping us create better comfort for every home.
